opportunities.title: Use efficient cache lifetimes
opportunities.description: A long cache lifetime can speed up repeat visits to your page. [Learn more about caching](https://developer.chrome.com/docs/performance/insights/cache).

opportunities.title: Tables do not use `<caption>` instead of cells with the `[colspan]` attribute to indicate a caption.
opportunities.description: Screen readers have features to make navigating tables easier. Ensuring that tables use the actual caption element instead of cells with the `[colspan]` attribute may improve the experience for screen reader users. [Learn more about captions](https://dequeuniversity.com/rules/axe/4.11/table-fake-caption).

opportunities.title: Background and foreground colors do not have a sufficient contrast ratio.
opportunities.description: Low-contrast text is difficult or impossible for many users to read. [Learn how to provide sufficient color contrast](https://dequeuniversity.com/rules/axe/4.11/color-contrast).

opportunities.title: Font display
opportunities.description: Consider setting [font-display](https://developer.chrome.com/docs/performance/insights/font-display) to swap or optional to ensure text is consistently visible. swap can be further optimized to mitigate layout shifts with [font metric overrides](https://developer.chrome.com/blog/font-fallbacks).

opportunities.title: Reduce unused CSS
opportunities.description: Reduce unused rules from stylesheets and defer CSS not used for above-the-fold content to decrease bytes consumed by network activity. [Learn how to reduce unused CSS](https://developer.chrome.com/docs/lighthouse/performance/unused-css-rules/).

opportunities.title: Page is blocked from indexing
opportunities.description: Search engines are unable to include your pages in search results if they don't have permission to crawl them. [Learn more about crawler directives](https://developer.chrome.com/docs/lighthouse/seo/is-crawlable/).

opportunities.title: Document does not have a valid `rel=canonical`
opportunities.description: Canonical links suggest which URL to show in search results. [Learn more about canonical links](https://developer.chrome.com/docs/lighthouse/seo/canonical/).

opportunities.title: Image elements do not have `[alt]` attributes
opportunities.description: Informative elements should aim for short, descriptive alternate text. Decorative elements can be ignored with an empty alt attribute. [Learn more about the `alt` attribute](https://dequeuniversity.com/rules/axe/4.11/image-alt).
